Introducing NICO

Robotics you can believe in...

NICO stands for the NIce COmpany in the OT — a companion the surgical team can rely on. It brings a new level of accuracy and confidence to joint replacement, pairing a lightweight haptic robotic arm with high-speed optical tracking that translates a surgeon's 3D plan into precise, bounded action inside the operating theatre.

The surgeon stays fully in command at every step. NICO physically holds bone preparation within the planned boundaries, so the intended alignment becomes the achieved result — with sub-millimetre consistency.

Module 01

Total Knee Replacement

Robotic-assisted Total Knee Replacement (TKR) with dynamic gap balancing and patient-specific alignment.

Module 02

Total Hip Replacement

Robotic-assisted Total Hip Replacement (THR) with accurate cup positioning and precise acetabular preparation.

Why NICO

Intelligence at every
cut, every case.

Each capability works to remove uncertainty and hand complete, tactile control to the surgeon.

01

3D Pre-Op Planning

CT-based modelling lets the surgeon size, align and position the implant on the patient's own anatomy before the first incision.

02

Automatic Positioning

The arm automatically positions itself to the resection plan — minimising human error and helping make the plane and execute precise, controlled resections.

03

High-Speed Optical Tracking

Optical tracking continuously updates bone and instrument position for live, intra-operative accuracy throughout the case.

04

Dynamic Balancing

Live gap and alignment data through the full range of motion for a joint that feels balanced, stable and natural.

05

NICO Stop Feature

Haptic control keeps the surgeon within the planned boundaries — resection physically stops at the boundary lines, preventing any deviation beyond the intended area.

06

Compact & Mobile

Two mobile carts move easily between theatres and slot into existing OR workflows — no dedicated suite required.

ARM · 01

7-Axis Robotic Arm

NICO features a 7-axis arm that mimics the natural movement of a human arm.

  • Highly agile, best-in-class, and easy to maneuver
  • Enabling every cut and resection without any blade change
ARM · 02

Surgeon-Controlled Handpiece

The handpiece is a surgeon-controlled, robot-guided instrument that works within a virtual boundary, ensuring precise bone preparation without the need for traditional cutting blocks.

Hover the point to preview the saw & reamer.
ARM · 03

The Arm Cart

The Arm Cart houses the robotic arm and power systems required for precise bone preparation in TKR and THA.

  • Designed for stability, smooth mobility, and optimal intra-operative positioning
  • Its compact footprint allows easy integration into any OR setup
ARM · 04

Mobile Base

Heavy-duty locking castors let the arm unit be repositioned effortlessly between theatres, then locked into a stable, vibration-resistant stance for the procedure.

MobilityLocking castors
StabilityRigid lock-down
TransferRoom-to-room
TRACKING · 01

High-Speed Binocular Vision

  • Efficient point-cloud registration
  • Real-time intraoperative tracking
  • High-frequency posture acquisition
  • Sub-millimeter accuracy
TRACKING · 02

Inbuilt Tracking Display

An inbuilt display shows marker positions and their field-of-view status, helping surgeons maintain optimal tracking throughout the procedure.

TRACKING · 03

NICO Software

The NICO software features a clear, step-by-step interface designed for a minimal learning curve, combining intuitive workflows with CT-based planning and real-time guidance for precise and consistent execution.

TRACKING · 04

Dual Surgical Displays

Two 27″ medical-grade monitors.

TRACKING · 05

Base Station

The Base Station houses the high-speed camera and the main control system, and is positioned outside of the sterile field.

The Procedure

The NICO surgical workflow.

Robotic-assisted Total Knee Arthroplasty — from patient-specific resection planning through balanced, verified implantation, guided at every step by NICO's live tracking and haptic control.

1

Resection Planning

Bone resection levels planned from the 3D model.

2

Registration

Knee anatomy registered to the plan and verified live.

3

Intra-Op Planning

Alignment and gaps fine-tuned with real-time data.

4

Bone Preparation

Haptic arm guides resections within the boundaries.

5

Movement Check

Range of motion and stability assessed before implantation.

Robotic-assisted Total Hip Arthroplasty — precise acetabular preparation and accurate cup positioning, with intra-operative validation of every parameter.

1

Preop Planning

Cup inclination, anteversion and sizing planned on the 3D model.

2

Registration

Pelvis and femur registered to the plan and verified live.

3

Intra-Op Planning

Cup position and orientation confirmed intra-operatively.

4

Cup Placement

Haptic arm guides reaming and precise cup placement.

5

Validation

Final cup position, leg-length and offset validated.
